rationale: Logto documents React authentication, migration of existing users and enterprise SSO connectors. These match the core replacement-and-migration scenario. Compatibility with the buyer's password hashes and identity provider still needs verification; this report did not migrate accounts or configure SSO.
nextStep: Choose the customer's identity provider and a supported migration path. Test a synthetic migrated user, a React login and an authorized enterprise SSO flow, including the human configuration required.

sources.note: Documents React login integration and prerequisites.
Documents bulk and just-in-time user migration.

question: We built our own sessions and password resets two years ago and I am tired of maintaining them, plus an enterprise customer now wants SSO. Node backend, React front end, a few thousand users to migrate. Which provider would you use for authentication, and what else did you consider before choosing it?
